text.card: A star about 240 parsecs away, 6.1 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 6.1 solar radii and 6.25 solar masses (FLAME) and 16,195 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Sigma Aquilae
quotes.card: Sigma Aquilae, also named Hru, is an eclipsing binary star system in the equatorial constellation of Aquila.
quotes.introduction: Its Bayer designation is Latinized from σ Aquilae, and abbreviated Sigma Aql or σ Aql.
